name: Yamada Seiji
source:
A teacher in charge of student guidance. With long years of employment, he is well-trusted by the school.

He is often summoning [url=/c95194]Kuzuhara[/url] and [url=/c95193]Shiina[/url] under the pretext of guidance.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
